unsupported_or_overstated_claims: The 02:10 concentration alone proves the timestamp is only ETL and not a human decision or workflow-related event.
The QC team is not slow and the dashboard problem is entirely fake.
The extracts and timestamp semantics are sufficiently understood to justify replacing the KPI timestamp without first checking the SOP definition, source freshness, or event-log semantics.
strongest_alternative_interpretation: The 02:10 pattern may indicate an interface commit or batch release rather than the decision time, but it does not establish whether upstream QC workflow delay exists; apparent cycle time may mix workflow delay with interface timing, and the extracts may not represent the same point-in-time snapshot.
single_most_valuable_next_improvement: Request the SOP definition of the cycle-start event and a small event-level sample containing evidence-available, approval/decision, and QCore release timestamps, with source extraction times. Use it to separate workflow delay from interface timing before changing the KPI.
